actions.command: if [ x$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE = xtrue ]; then /usr/bin/nmcli radio wifi on; else /usr/bin/nmcli radio wifi off; fi
actions.update-command: if LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/nmcli radio wifi | /usr/bin/grep -qx enabled; then /usr/bin/printf true; else /usr/bin/printf false; fi; /usr/bin/sleep 0.05

actions.command: if [ x$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE = xtrue ]; then /usr/bin/bluetoothctl power on; else /usr/bin/bluetoothctl power off; fi
actions.update-command: if LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/bluetoothctl show | /usr/bin/grep -q 'Powered: yes'; then /usr/bin/printf true; else /usr/bin/printf false; fi; /usr/bin/sleep 0.05

actions.command: if [ x$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE = xtrue ]; then /usr/bin/wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ 0; else /usr/bin/wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ 1; fi
actions.update-command: if LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/wpctl get-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ | /usr/bin/grep -q MUTED; then /usr/bin/printf false; else /usr/bin/printf true; fi; /usr/bin/sleep 0.05

actions.command: if [ x$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE = xtrue ]; then /usr/bin/wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 0; else /usr/bin/wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 1; fi
actions.update-command: if LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/wpctl get-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ | /usr/bin/grep -q MUTED; then /usr/bin/printf false; else /usr/bin/printf true; fi; /usr/bin/sleep 0.05
